text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Father confesses to poisoning children because of jealousy.
- Opposition angry over prime minister's comments, wants action from king.
- King calls for international probe into effects of Israeli actions in Jerusalem.
- King arrives in Qatar, hails his talks in Bahrain.
- King tries to end Qatar-Bahrain dispute.
- Prince Hassan says stand on Jerusalem is not for personal gains.
- Prince Hassan voices Jordan's opposition to any tampering with Jerusalem's status.
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu telephoned Prince Hassan, promised to review tunnel decision, asked for intervention by Egyptian President Mubarak to cool situation.
- Gold trader commits suicide by swallowing cyanide.
- King says Jordan shocked by Israeli measures.
- Government plans to issue new economic package as temporary laws.
